cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you announce the race winner, apologize for starting me behind the shed. We'll deal with the result afterward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Placement isn't starting position. I spent ten seconds finding the track; please include that in the apology.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep 'mistake'. Add that it gave me a worse start than everyone else. Please read that back before you move to the winner.
